One journey, different stages

Find your child’s next step.

Use these stages to start a conversation. The office can explain the current curriculum, entry requirements and class availability.

Nursery & KG

A beginning full of discovery

A first look at school life. Visit the early-years spaces and talk about age requirements and settling into a new routine.

Ask about this stage →
01
Classes 1–5

Build the foundations

Reading, writing and numbers form the foundation. Ask the team about the curriculum, classroom language and daily learning routine.

Ask about this stage →
02
Classes 6–8

Explore more questions

The middle-school years open up new subjects. Talk with the school about subject learning, practice and classroom expectations.

Ask about this stage →
03
Classes 9–10

Look ahead with purpose

Understand the RBSE secondary stage. Ask about subjects, assessment and the approach to preparing for board examinations.

Ask about this stage →
04
Classes 11–12

Choose your direction

Science, Commerce and Arts. Confirm the current subject combinations, eligibility and availability directly with the school office.

Ask about this stage →
05

See the spaces where learning happens.

Ask about class-wise use, current facilities and subject requirements during your visit.

Before choosing a stream

Make the choice with clear information.

For Classes 11–12, discuss interests, subject combinations, eligibility and next steps with the school. Science, Commerce and Arts are available as streams; individual subject choices need confirmation.
